name: Dracula: A Love Story
source:
Modern art restorer Laia Burnell touches a set of Ottoman paintings – and finds herself living centuries earlier as Lale Hatun. Amid palace secrets, forbidden love, and supernatural mysteries, she encounters faces she recognizes from her present life. 

With the help of Vlad, Leo, Sandra, and Noe, Laia must untangle past and present before the lines between them vanish forever.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Dracula:_A_Love_Story]romance-club.fandom[/url]
